title: Northern Employee Benefits Services Pension Plan Act
verified_how: Register page 'NORTHERN EMPLOYEE BENEFITS SERVICES PENSION PLAN ACT, Official Consolidation of', listed under N in the Current Consolidated Statutes and Regulations, with a legal notice last updated 20 February 2025 (NoticeCSNucN10_E_0.pdf, headed 'Northern Employee Benefits Services Pension Plan Act / C.S.Nu.,c.N-10 / Notice under subsection 65(2) of the Legislation Act'). The consolidation PDF's cover prints 'OFFICIAL CONSOLIDATION OF NORTHERN EMPLOYEE BENEFITS SERVICES PENSION PLAN ACT / (C.S.Nu.,c.N-10) / In force October 1, 2015 / (Consolidation date: May 31, 2024) / S.Nu. 2015,c.10 / AS AMENDED BY NUNAVUT STATUTES'. In force; not repealed; the Act's page carries no 'not up to date' warning.
notes: Nunavut's own statute (not a carried-over NWT Act), enacted in parallel with the NWT's Northern Employee Benefits Services Pension Plan Act, S.N.W.T. 2015, c.6, for the same multi-employer northern pension plan covering municipal, housing and health-authority employees in both territories. The contributory public pensions are federal and out of scope: Canada Pension Plan, R.S.C. 1985, c. C-8 and Old Age Security Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. O-9. Government of Nunavut public servants are in the federal public service plan. The register also carries a Legislative Assembly Retiring Allowances Act and a Supplementary Retiring Allowances Act, covering MLAs only.
